name: Volubilis
blurb: Volubilis is a UNESCO World Heritage site in Morocco featuring extensive ruins of a major Roman and Berber city. Visitors explore ancient structures like the Arch of Caracalla, temples, and preserved mosaic floors.

positive: Loved visiting the well-preserved ruins and mosaics
Highlights include amazing tile work and ancient architecture
Great archaeological site to explore with few crowds
negative: Mention of rainy weather during the visit

quotes.text: Visiting Volubilis? Mosaics? Loved it there.

Now that we have wifi again...
Volubilis!
1) Temple
2) House of Orpheus
3) Shopping arcade
4) House of the Horseman

Yes, it rained on us! Fortunately, the 2500-year-old storm drains worked perfectly!

For years, we traveled around looking at at archeological sites (I blame having old Nat Geo magazines). Of all of the places we visited, I think Volubilis, in Morocco was one of the best.

Especially the amazing tile work.

#morocco #africa #travel #photography #canon #archeology

Volubilis, Morocco... near Meknes in Morocco, is a well-preserved UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring ancient Roman ruins, notably the best-preserved Roman city in Morocco. Established on a pre-Roman Berber settlement, it became a prosperous Roman city in the 1st century AD
